featured.title: Job Bot
featured.description: A desktop app that finds jobs that fit my resume, explains every decision it makes, and helps me apply. It pulls fresh openings from 140+ company boards and LinkedIn / Naukri alert emails, scores each one with Gemini, drafts cover notes, and auto-fills applications. The final submit is always left to me.

featured.title: Complaint Management System
featured.description: A Freshdesk / Jira-style ticketing system for MGIMS Sevagram. Staff raise a ticket by department and request type, and agents work their queues against per-priority SLAs. A knowledge base suggests help articles before a ticket is even raised.
highlights: SLA clocks with business hours + breach alerts
Staff / Agent / Admin roles, automation rules

featured.title: Mortuary Management
featured.description: The mortuary module of a hospital information system. It has a live dashboard with chamber occupancy, a body board and open alerts. It covers the whole flow: intake, outside-death registration, MLC, autopsy requests, body transfers, family release approvals and chain of custody.

featured.title: MGIMS Sevagram Website
featured.description: The public website for Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences and Kasturba Hospital, plus an admin console where each department edits its own content. Built to India's UX4G government design handbook, with automated accessibility tests on every push.
highlights: Per-page SEO tags, sitemap & CI pipeline

featured.title: Nature Frost
featured.description: A fast, statically exported website for a frozen fruits and vegetables brand, with a product catalogue, a downloadable brochure and a contact flow.

earlier.title: Stumart
earlier.description: Marketplace to sell used items with CRUD APIs, auth, AI descriptions, search, pagination, and AI-powered filters. Responsive frontend with Next.js and TailwindCSS.

earlier.title: Cryptoverse
earlier.description: Responsive app for real-time cryptocurrency analysis and tracking with Context API, CoinGecko and Bing News, and interactive Chart.js visualizations.

earlier.description: Real estate marketplace with data-driven listings, advanced sorting and filtering by location, property type, and more.
